title: feat(spec,app-shell): controlled_by_parent refusal carries a code; Studio settings tab words it in en and zh
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi973kVV4iHmicnT3W3avzhv3)_
Fixes #36526
Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:Studio 里给对象选「跟随所属的主记录」却没有合适的主从字段时,设置页现在用中文或英文的业务话说明哪里不对、该改哪个字段,不再显示带 ADR 编号的英文开发者原文。
- 为什么做:属于 Studio 文案业务化专题,接着上一张设置页去掉 ADR 编号的改动,把这条拒绝提示也改成作者能看懂的话。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是提示文字措辞不准或退回英文原文,保存是否被拒的判断不变;可以直接撤回本 PR。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

**Spec (`@objectstack/spec`).** The `controlled_by_parent` master refusal now carries a machine-readable code. Both raise sites, `ObjectSchema`'s refinement (`refuseControlledByParentWithoutOneMaster`) and `defineStack`'s extension-merge gate (`applyControlledByParentExtensionGate`), stamp `params: { code: CONTROLLED_BY_PARENT_MASTER_INVALID, shape }` on the issue. `shape` is the existing published `ControlledByParentMasterShape`. The new constant and a `ControlledByParentMasterIssueParams` type are exported from `@objectstack/spec/data`, and the code is registered in `ERROR_CODE_LEDGER` under `@objectstack/spec` (the `PLUGIN_UI_REQUIRED_KEY_MISSING` precedent: a code on a zod issue's `params.code`, door `none`). Which objects are refused, and at which path, is unchanged.

Where the code is visible: on the zod issue itself (any `ObjectSchema` / `ObjectStackDefinitionSchema` `safeParse`, which is the Studio tab's path) and on `defineStack`'s `STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID` refusal, whose `issues` are the raw zod issues (measured on this head: `objects.0.sharingModel` carries `{ code, shape: 'no-master' }`). Where it is not: the metadata save door's `422 INVALID_METADATA`. Its `issues[]` entries come from `zodIssuesToMetadataIssues` (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`) and keep `path`, `message` and zod's issue code (`custom`) only. The const's JSDoc, the ledger row's comment and the changeset say exactly this. Carrying `params` through that envelope would be a wire change and is not made here.

The three English message arms drop the developer citation: `ADR-0055 §1: since @objectstack/spec 18, …` becomes `Since @objectstack/spec 18, …`. The prescription in each arm is unchanged. Card re-check: `grep -n "ADR-0055 §1" packages/spec/src/data/controlled-by-parent-master.ts` now hits docblock lines only, no message line.

**Studio (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/i18n`).** `cbpMasterRefusal` (owd-sharing.ts) still parses the save door's `ObjectSchema` on a probe, and now returns `{ message, shape, fields }`: it reads the shape off the issue only when `params.code` is the spec's code, and lists the fields the author has to act on. `ObjectSettingsPanel` renders the `studio` namespace row the shape selects (`engine.studio.settings.cbpRefusal*`, six shapes, en and zh), naming the fields by label (key when unlabeled). With no code on the issue, or a shape with no row, it shows the spec's message as before. The shape-to-key map is typed on the spec's shape union, so a new shape fails type-check until it has a row. The probe now also carries the master's writability flags: on a `master_detail` field it copies `readonly` and `system` when they are booleans, exactly as written (the spec's module-private `UNWRITABLE_MASTER_FLAGS`, hard-coded in owd-sharing.ts with a comment naming it; no new spec export). Before, the probe dropped both flags, so a master marked `readonly: true` or `system: true` was refused by the save door (shape `master-not-writable`) while the tab showed nothing. Now the tab shows that shape's row. The field that row names is the master as the parse reads it: the one `master_detail` declared `required: true`, else the object's only `master_detail` (on the parsed map an omitted `required` is `false`, the optional master). Reading it off the raw probe named no field for a flagged master that writes no `required`, and the row printed an empty name. `cbpMasterRefusal` takes the issue whose `params.code` is the spec's code, and falls back to the custom issue at `sharingModel` / `fields` only when none carries it. The en `required-lookup-only` wording has a one-field row and a several-field row (`cbpRefusalRequiredLookupsOnly`); zh carries both keys for parity. The stale docblock claim "The spec does not export the check" is corrected: `controlledByParentMasterRefusal` is exported; the probe keeps parsing `ObjectSchema` so the code it reads is the one the save door stamps.

Naming: the code name `CONTROLLED_BY_PARENT_MASTER_INVALID` is accepted by seat ruling 7088548226 on this PR (precedent: the spec's `<SUBJECT>_INVALID` refusal codes such as `STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID` and `DATASET_INVALID`).

Route chosen: one new ledger code plus the existing `shape` vocabulary as the sub-discriminator. The shape alone does not identify the refusal family on an arbitrary issue, and ADR-0112 registers a code that ships in `dist`.

Generated artifacts regenerated: `packages/spec/api-surface/data.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/data.json`, `content/docs/references/api/{error-code-ledger,contract,automation-api}.mdx`.

## Tests

Changed tests (forced by the change):
- `packages/spec/src/data/object.test.ts`: the two `toMatch` pins that ended in `ADR-0055 §1:` and the two `toContain('since @objectstack/spec 18, …')` pins now read `Since @objectstack/spec 18, …`; `issuesOf` also returns `params`.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/owd-sharing.test.ts`: the three `cbpMasterRefusal(...)` equality pins compare `.message`.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectSettingsPanel.cbpRequiredMaster-12326.test.tsx`: the two cases that expected the spec text verbatim in `owd-cbp-refusal` now expect the business wording.

New assertions:
- `object.test.ts`: every reachable shape (`no-master`, `required-lookup-only`, `several-masters`, `several-required-masters`, `master-not-writable`) carries `params` equal to `{ code: CONTROLLED_BY_PARENT_MASTER_INVALID, shape }`, and no message matches `ADR-`.
- `stack-cbp-extension-master.test.ts`: the extension-merge issue carries the same `params`.
- `owd-sharing.test.ts`: shape and named fields per shape, including `master-not-writable` for a master marked `readonly` or `system` (and no refusal when both are `false`), and the same shape naming the master when it writes no `required`; the shape equals the one on the save door's issue; the key map covers all six shapes; the spec-parity cases add a readonly required master and a system optional master.
- `ObjectSettingsPanel.cbpRequiredMaster-12326.test.tsx`: a new describe renders five shapes in eight cases (a readonly and a system required master, and a readonly master that writes no `required`, all show the `master-not-writable` row naming the field; one required lookup and two required lookups take the one-field and several-field rows) in en-US and zh-CN and checks the exact row text, that zh differs from en, and that neither contains `ADR-`, `@objectstack/spec`, `sharingModel`, `master_detail` or `required: `.

<details><summary>Ablation (one reading, then restored)</summary>

Mutation via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`: the refinement's `code: CONTROLLED_BY_PARENT_MASTER_INVALID` replaced with `code: 'ABLATION_36526'`. Anchor 1 to 0, blob 723be4e61c3b to 3889e32b7048. Spec rebuilt; `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/spec ABLATION_36526` found the marker in 2 dist files.
- spec `object.test.ts` + `stack-cbp-extension-master.test.ts`: 1 failed / 227 passed (`no-master: expected { code: 'ABLATION_36526', …(1) } to deeply equal { …(2) }`).
- ui `owd-sharing.test.ts` + `ObjectSettingsPanel.cbpRequiredMaster-12326.test.tsx`: 11 failed / 30 passed (the shape reads `undefined`, the panel falls back to the spec text).
Restore: blob back to HEAD 723be4e61c3b, `git diff HEAD` empty; spec rebuilt; `--absent` preflight: marker absent from all 614 built files, working tree clean.

Second reading, for the flag carry (patch round 1, head ca3ebc278): `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the probe's flag copy in `owd-sharing.ts` with a no-op (anchor 1 to 0, blob fb3c3868fd74 to bd773cd5b26b; the tests read this source directly, no build in between). `owd-sharing.test.ts` + `ObjectSettingsPanel.cbpRequiredMaster-12326.test.tsx`: 5 failed / 41 passed, the five readonly/system cases. Restore: blob back to HEAD fb3c3868fd74, `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status --porcelain` empty.

Third reading, for the master resolution (patch round 2, head c8366b960): `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` made the only-`master_detail` arm of `refusalFields` return no field (anchor 1 to 0, blob be67de10e803 to 25dda5fdf07b; source read directly, no build). `owd-sharing.test.ts` + `ObjectSettingsPanel.cbpRequiredMaster-12326.test.tsx`: 2 failed / 46 passed, the two omitted-`required` cases. Restore: blob back to HEAD be67de10e803, `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status --porcelain` empty.
</details>

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 875 passed, Tests 27973 passed, 1 todo.
- `ui` vitest `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/` + `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/studio-namespace.test.ts`: Test Files 356 passed, Tests 2791 passed.
- Downstream refusal suites (metadata-protocol 2 files 50 tests, objectql 2 files 38 tests, plugin-security 4 files 187 tests, lint 5 files 826 tests): all passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`, `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check`, `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 artifacts up to date.
- Gate list from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at 2d20f933c: 126 derived, 125 run with exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED (`pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: PREREQUISITE NOT MET, it reads every package's dist and this box has no full build; CI carries it). `--ran` reconciliation: 126 accounted, 0 unrun.
- Patch round 1 (head ca3ebc278): `owd-sharing.test.ts`, `ObjectSettingsPanel.cbpRequiredMaster-12326.test.tsx`, `ObjectSettingsPanel.businessWording-36512.test.tsx`, `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.cbpRequiredMaster-12326.test.tsx` and `studio-namespace.test.ts`: 5 files / 85 tests passed; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exit 0. `dispatch-gates --commands` at ca3ebc278 derives the same 126 families as at 2d20f933c (no family newly touched), so none was re-run; `--ran` reconciliation still 126 accounted, 1 NOT MEASURED.
- Patch round 2 (head c8366b960): spec build, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` and `object.test.ts` + `stack-cbp-extension-master.test.ts` + `error-code-ledger.test.ts` + `controlled-by-parent-master.test.ts`: 4 files / 301 tests passed; `check:generated` all 14 up to date. ui targeted suites (the same five files): 87 tests passed; `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check exit 0. `dispatch-gates --commands` at c8366b960 derives the same 126 families (none newly touched); the twelve that read the changed text (error-code casing, dispatcher vocabulary, status conformance, the three changeset gates, doc-authoring, nul-bytes, issue-citations, error-code-provenance, api-surface, ui `scripts/`) were re-run, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation 126 accounted, 1 NOT MEASURED.
- All other readings above were taken at head 2d20f933c (after merging origin/main ad50d611a), except the full spec suite, the full studio-design suite and the ablation, which ran before the merge (at bc5a55626 and a6b5ec9b2, whose source is identical; a6b5ec9b2 adds only the changeset); the targeted refusal suites were re-run after the merge: spec `src/data/` + stack + ledger 191 files / 6806 tests passed, ui 5 files / 80 tests passed.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Card claim: the governing `Claim:` on #36526 is comment 7088513159, naming this card thread's branch `claude/project-thread-h6ofg9`.
- `master-not-required` cannot reach the tab through a raw parse (an omitted `required` defaults to `false` first); its row exists for completeness.

## Verification

Read first: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/owd-sharing.ts` (`refusalShape`, `refusalFields`), `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` (the refinement's `params`), `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/zh.ts` (the six rows).

Two-minute check: in Studio, open an object with no master-detail field, set sharing to "Follows its parent record" with the console in Chinese. Expected: the red line under the picker reads 「该对象设为「跟随所属的主记录」,但它没有可跟随的主从关系字段,因此无法保存。…」 with no ADR number.
